## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (52%)** · Unreliable input · Defer to expert
Flagged resampled frozen section nearly ties InSitu (46%); margin call deferred [F7].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Invasive 52%, InSitu 46%, Normal 1%, Benign 1% [F1] | Nearly tied Invasive vs InSitu |
| Conformal set | {Invasive} (10% alpha, 90% coverage) | Single class; dataset-level guarantee |
| Reliability / OOD | 44% reliability (flagged), 100% OOD [F6] | Suspect resampled frozen section |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Disagree | Independent models disagree |
| Similar cases | 2/5 (40%) Invasive, 3/5 InSitu [F5] | Nearest neighbors favor InSitu |

## Tissue evidence
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (region 7) · ↑ invasive · Scarce (-0.57, +0.95 contribution), 0/20 spot-check [F2] · Unreliable
- **Gland / tubule formation** (region 7) · ↑ invasive · Scarce (-0.62, +0.62 contribution), caption-inconsistent, 18/20 spot-check [F3] · Weak
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (region 9) · ↑ invasive · Below-typical (+0.39 contribution), 20/20 spot-check [F4] · Validated
- **Tumor necrosis** (regions 1, 4, 6) · ↑ invasive · Elevated (+0.20 contribution), 3/20 spot-check · Unreliable

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful; top-3 risk deletion beats random (0.0114, 95% CI 0.0021–0.0197).
- **Concepts**: Unproven by deletion (0.0008, 95% CI -0.0088–0.0064); leans on unreliable normal lobules (0/20), necrosis (3/20).

## Could be wrong if
- InSitu (46%) is true, matching top-3 neighbors (68%–70% similarity, contrast case BACH_0242).
- Resampling artifact (severity 3, 100% OOD) distorts tissue; validated invasion (-0.16) and pleomorphism (-0.13) oppose invasive.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 6, 5, 2**: Inspect highest-risk areas (82%, 81%, 57%) to separate invasion from in situ carcinoma.
2. **Regions 7, 9**: Verify whether normal lobules, tubules, and stroma are absent or obscured by artifact.
3. **Region 10**: Check infiltrating stroma (highest invasion score); consider drafted recut H&E or deeper levels.
